subject.title: fix(scripts): restore Testbox lease claims to the originating repo after delegated runs

question: Should the project accept post-run rewriting of a retained Testbox claim's `repoRoot` when it still points to the wrapper-created sparse-sync checkout?
rationale: The change intentionally mutates the ownership sidecar that protects Testbox lease reuse, and the protected maintainer workflow requires a human to confirm that this is the desired lifecycle boundary after live proof is supplied.

options.title: Accept after live reuse proof
options.body: Confirm the narrow restoration policy once a redacted real Testbox transcript shows that same-repository lease reuse succeeds without weakening foreign-claim rejection.

options.title: Keep explicit reclaim semantics
options.body: Reject automatic restoration if maintainers want every delegated lease handoff to continue requiring an explicit ownership reclaim.

recommendation.title: Accept after live reuse proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the narrow restoration policy once a redacted real Testbox transcript shows that same-repository lease reuse succeeds without weakening foreign-claim rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the active author of the Testbox wrapper repair; no stronger current-main ownership trail was available in the supplied context.
